creative_direction: Create a cobalt sphere resting inside a curved concrete niche. Keep the sphere in the lower center, partially shaded by the niche wall. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
